detail:
Decisions: Chose to run the network-dependent rungs (npx, npm-prefix, global) as child processes with an elapsed-time guard instead of exec, falling through to the bundled server only when they die inside a grace window — exec replaced the shell so a registry-policy failure killed the launch outright, but a server that actually served and then exited must never be silently restarted because its client handshake is already spent; elapsed time is the only signal available without a pipe, which would break stdio passthrough; Chose a 20-second default grace, overridable via TWINING_LAUNCH_RUNG_GRACE — package-resolution failures die in under a second while real sessions last minutes, so the window is wide enough to be unambiguous and the env var makes the after-serving branch testable without a 20-second test; Chose NOT to reorder the ladder to prefer the bundled server over npx — that would silently downgrade every plugin user to keyword-only search to fix a minority failure; falling back on demand preserves semantic search for everyone whose registry works
Findings: ROOT CAUSE of the field outage, found by Dave: an npmrc policy requiring packages be at least 7 days old. npx exists and `npx --version` succeeds, so resolve_runner commits to the npx rung, then `npx -y twining-mcp` is refused by the registry. Because the rung used exec, the shell was replaced and rung 4 — the dependency-free bundled server needing no registry at all — was never reached.; warning: `--probe` reporting runner=npx does NOT mean the server can launch. The probe checks `npx --version`, not that npx can fetch the package. Any registry policy, auth failure, proxy, or offline state produces a healthy-looking probe and a dead launch. The README's guidance that runner=none is the smoking gun is therefore incomplete — a healthy probe does not exclude a launch failure.; My initial H1b detector over-counted: the >80-char 'sentence fragment' heuristic flags legitimate long option strings written via the structured path. Inspecting 185 flagged dogfood decisions, the first several were well-formed with real reason_rejected text. The unambiguous signal is reason_rejected === 'Not chosen' alone: 1100/1226 in field (89.7%) and 164/258 dogfood (63.6%). H1b holds strongly on that signal; the fragment heuristic added only ~2 points and should not be trusted.; Confirmed the corruption is confined to the NL-string path: decisions recorded via the structured object form carry real reason_rejected text. record-tools.ts:94-97 maps every NL-extracted alternative to the placeholder.
summary: Merged deep-review branch to main; fixed launcher exec-away-the-fallback bug that caused the field outage
